schema_version: 1
id: qwen3-tts-ascend-910b1
title: Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice on one Ascend 910B1
kind: standalone_engine
model:
  id: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice
  provider: Qwen
  task: text_to_speech
engine:
  id: qwen3-tts-engine
  name: qwen3-tts-engine
  repository: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/qwen3-tts-engine
  ref: b4451682abac651f26046f8d27467de3f007e1e7
runtime:
  backend: ascend
  precision: bf16
hardware:
  vendor: Huawei
  model: Ascend 910B1
  device_count: 1
environment:
  os: Linux (prepared Ascend environment; distribution not recorded)
  requirements:
  - One allocated Ascend 910B1; Python 3.12 with CANN and Triton Ascend already installed.
  - 'Prepared environment: torch 2.10.0, torch_npu 2.10.0.post4, qwen-tts 0.1.1, transformers 4.57.3.'
  - Preserve the CANN PYTHONPATH; the repository does not install the NPU driver or toolchain.
  - Recorded ARM64 allocator workaround requires /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so.2.
  - GitHub, Python package index and Hugging Face access are required for initial installation and model download.
commands:
  install: |
    git clone https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/qwen3-tts-engine.git
    cd qwen3-tts-engine
    git checkout b4451682abac651f26046f8d27467de3f007e1e7
    python -m pip install --no-deps -e .
    npu-smi info
    python -c "import torch, torch_npu, triton, qwen_tts; assert torch.npu.is_available()"
    export QWEN_TTS_MODEL="$PWD/models/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice"
    HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0 python - <<'PY'
    import os
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
    snapshot_download(repo_id="Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice",
                      revision="0c0e3051f131929182e2c023b9537f8b1c68adfe",
                      local_dir=os.environ["QWEN_TTS_MODEL"])
    PY
  serve: |
    export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES-0}"
    export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4
    export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
    export LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so.2
    python - <<'PY'
    import json
    import os
    import subprocess
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path
    command = json.loads(Path("evidence/campaign-20261017/plan/continuous-direct-prompt-command.json").read_text())
    command[0] = sys.executable
    command[command.index("--model") + 1] = os.environ["QWEN_TTS_MODEL"]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)
    PY
  request: |
    curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:8099/health
    python - <<'PY'
    import base64
    import json
    import urllib.request
    import wave
    payload = {"input": "Hello from the Ascend engine.", "voice": "Ryan", "language": "English",
               "response_format": "pcm", "stream_format": "sse", "seed": 42, "max_new_tokens": 2048}
    request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8099/v1/audio/speech",
        data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    finished = False
    sample_rate = None
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=1800) as response, wave.open("output.wav", "wb") as wav:
        wav.setnchannels(1)
        wav.setsampwidth(2)
        for line in response:
            if not line.startswith(b"data: "):
                continue
            event = json.loads(line[6:])
            if event["type"] == "speech.audio.error":
                raise RuntimeError(event["error"])
            if event["type"] == "speech.audio.delta":
                if sample_rate is None:
                    sample_rate = event["sample_rate"]
                    wav.setframerate(sample_rate)
                elif sample_rate != event["sample_rate"]:
                    raise RuntimeError("Sample rate changed during streaming")
                wav.writeframes(base64.b64decode(event["audio"]))
            elif event["type"] == "speech.audio.done":
                finished = True
                print("Finish reason:", event["finish_reason"])
    if not finished:
        raise RuntimeError("Stream ended without completion")
    print("Saved output.wav")
    PY
  benchmark: |
    python -m qwen3_tts_engine.benchmark \
      --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8099/v1/audio/speech \
      --model Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice \
      --engine independent --source-revision "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
      --workload evidence/campaign-20261017/plan/workload-128.jsonl \
      --output runs/local-c4 --concurrency 4 --requests 128 --warmup 4 --frame-rate 12.5
deployment:
  status: unverified
  last_verified_at: null
  evidence_url: null
acceptance:
  verdict: INCONCLUSIVE
  issue_url: null
  evidence_url: null
maintainers:
- amy-why-3459
updated_at: '2026-10-19'
limitations:
- This catalog entry has not been executed on hardware during the 2026-10-19 documentation work.
- The historical PASS covers measured engine e783a64b0fb4f9ade2ffb3980b3e1f74a00c9a6a and its frozen contract; it
  does not qualify this deployment ref automatically.
- 'Historical evidence: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/qwen3-tts-engine/blob/b4451682abac651f26046f8d27467de3f007e1e7/evidence/campaign-20261017/acceptance.md'
- Only this CustomVoice checkpoint, one 910B1 and the recorded BF16 configuration are represented. The separate
  910B3 comparison is not validation of this recipe.
- Keep the install and serve blocks in the same activated shell. Send the request from a second terminal after health
  succeeds.
- The endpoint streams base64 PCM over SSE; it does not return a WAV directly. The OS distribution and CANN version
  were not fully frozen in the source documentation.

schema_version: 1
id: drama3-b300-fp8
title: Drama 3 native FP8 experts on one NVIDIA B300
kind: standalone_engine
model:
  id: fishaudio/drama-3
  provider: fishaudio
  task: text_to_speech
engine:
  id: drama-3-single-b300-engine
  name: drama-3-single-b300-engine
  repository: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/drama-3-single-b300-engine
  ref: 58a1882a4d941f8d21bfce6be37d3d5e7c9fde80
runtime:
  backend: cuda
  precision: fp8 experts / bf16 state and codec
hardware:
  vendor: NVIDIA
  model: B300
  device_count: 1
environment:
  os: Linux
  requirements:
  - One allocated NVIDIA B300, Python 3.12, uv, Git and curl.
  - NVIDIA driver compatible with the locked CUDA 13 runtime; requirements-runtime.lock is installed by scripts/install_runtime.py.
  - Fish Speech source is pinned to 541566932abbaebcb0a40e562a1f846738383f38; model revision is e0a9218aa48888270f06ef1ed9ea67622c0e17d2.
  - Initial package installation and checkpoint download require network access.
commands:
  install: |
    git clone https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/drama-3-single-b300-engine.git
    cd drama-3-single-b300-engine
    git checkout 58a1882a4d941f8d21bfce6be37d3d5e7c9fde80
    git clone https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech.git ../fish-speech
    git -C ../fish-speech checkout 541566932abbaebcb0a40e562a1f846738383f38
    python3 scripts/install_runtime.py --venv .venv --fish-source ../fish-speech
    .venv/bin/hf download fishaudio/drama-3 \
      --revision e0a9218aa48888270f06ef1ed9ea67622c0e17d2 --local-dir models/drama-3
  serve: |
    set -a
    . configs/benchmark-native-b300.env
    set +a
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES-0}" OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 .venv/bin/python -m drama3.server \
      --checkpoint models/drama-3 --fish-source ../fish-speech --slots 64 --port 18082
  request: |
    curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:18082/health
    curl --fail-with-body http://127.0.0.1:18082/v1/audio/speech \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"input":"Hello from Drama 3.","stream":true,"response_format":"pcm"}' \
      --output speech.pcm
  benchmark: null
deployment:
  status: unverified
  last_verified_at: null
  evidence_url: null
acceptance:
  verdict: INCONCLUSIVE
  issue_url: null
  evidence_url: null
maintainers:
- david6666666
updated_at: '2026-10-19'
limitations:
- This deployment ref has not been re-run on B300 during the catalog work; the Linux distribution is not frozen
  in the quickstart.
- 'Mixed precision is intentional: native FP8 experts, BF16 GDN state and BF16 codec. No all-FP8 claim is made.'
- Output is 44.1 kHz mono signed 16-bit PCM. Allow model load, graph capture and codec warmup to finish before sending
  requests.
- Historical matched results use standalone 33f6d7237196520be9f457d86df161264cbb087e and include incomplete baseline
  repetitions; they do not establish the all-concurrency 1.5x acceptance target.
- 'Historical configuration, quality and raw evidence: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/drama-3-single-b300-engine/blob/58a1882a4d941f8d21bfce6be37d3d5e7c9fde80/docs/current-results.md'
- Built with Fish Audio. Fish Audio Community License and dependency licenses apply; retain NOTICE and third_party_licenses.

  evidence_url: null

- hsliuustc0106
updated_at: '2026-10-19'
limitations:
- This recipe has not been re-run on Apple hardware during the 2026-10-19 catalog work.
- M4/16 GB and the exact checkpoint are documented in the historical spike, which measured an earlier mlx-audio
  adaptation rather than this deployment ref.
- 'Source for the hardware scope: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/vllm-omni-mlx/blob/210cc4e35e208b56d4146e7cc735952cde8ea24e/docs/spike-mlx-audio-qwen3-tts.md'
- The dependency ranges and model download are not a fully locked macOS environment or checkpoint revision. Record
  resolved versions, model snapshot and macOS release during remote validation.
- The 4-bit label describes the quantized checkpoint; embeddings and vocoder may retain higher precision.
- One model instance per process; generation is serialized. The demo API key is a local example; default host is

- No claim for every Apple Silicon SKU, ASR, speech-out chat or diffusion follows from this TTS recipe.

schema_version: 1
id: ouro-1-4b-rlt-h20-3e-bf16
title: Ouro-1.4B synchronous BF16 serving on one H20-3e
kind: standalone_engine
model:
  id: ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B
  provider: ByteDance
  task: text_generation
engine:
  id: vllm-rlt
  name: vllm-rlt
  repository: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/vllm-rlt
  ref: 9d601ceaf9af63121c742df5f584467e23630a0b
runtime:
  backend: cuda
  precision: bf16
hardware:
  vendor: NVIDIA
  model: H20-3e
  device_count: 1
environment:
  os: Linux
  requirements:
  - One allocated NVIDIA H20-3e; Linux, Git, curl, uv and Python 3.10+.
  - CUDA-enabled PyTorch 2.5+ and a compatible NVIDIA driver; use the Triton attention backend.
  - BF16 weights need roughly 3 GB before KV and runtime buffers; this first-request configuration bounds the KV
    pool and active sequences.
  - Initial installation and model download require package-index, GitHub and Hugging Face access.
commands:
  install: |
    git clone https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/vllm-rlt.git
    cd vllm-rlt
    git checkout 9d601ceaf9af63121c742df5f584467e23630a0b
    uv venv --python 3.10 .venv
    source .venv/bin/activate
    uv pip install -e .
    python - <<'PY'
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
    snapshot_download(repo_id="ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B",
                      revision="574fa66cb8bf5abdc979642d01cf2b79b16bfab1",
                      local_dir="./artifacts/models/Ouro-1.4B",
                      allow_patterns=["*.json", "*.safetensors", "*.model", "*.txt"])
    PY
  serve: |
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES-0}" python -m vllm_rlt.entrypoints.serve \
      --model ./artifacts/models/Ouro-1.4B --served-model-name ouro \
      --device cuda --dtype bfloat16 --attention-backend triton \
      --num-blocks 64 --max-num-seqs 1 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
  request: |
    curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
    curl --fail-with-body -sS http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"model":"ouro","prompt":"The capital of France is","max_tokens":32,"temperature":0,"exit_threshold":1.0,"stream":false}'
  benchmark: null
deployment:
  status: unverified
  last_verified_at: null
  evidence_url: null
acceptance:
  verdict: INCONCLUSIVE
  issue_url: null
  evidence_url: null
maintainers:
- bjf-frz
updated_at: '2026-10-19'
limitations:
- This exact deployment ref and first-request configuration have not been re-run on H20-3e during catalog work.
- H20-3e BF16 hardware scope is taken from the historical README benchmark; those earlier runtime results are not
  qualification of this ref or request.
- 'Source and historical protocol: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/vllm-rlt/blob/9d601ceaf9af63121c742df5f584467e23630a0b/README.md'
- Uses default synchronous execution and exit_threshold 1.0 (fixed four loops). It does not enable asynchronous
  scheduling, preemption, self-speculation or disaggregation.
- Async execution with preemption and async self-speculation have documented correctness/lifecycle limitations.
  The small KV pool is a first-request setting, not a throughput profile.
- Linux distribution and resolved CUDA/PyTorch/Triton versions must be captured during remote validation. Preserve
  scheduler-provided CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES instead of overriding it.

schema_version: 1
id: lfm2-5-350m-system1-l40s-fp16
title: LFM2.5-350M FP16 choice scoring on one NVIDIA L40S
kind: standalone_engine
model:
  id: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M
  provider: LiquidAI
  task: constrained_scoring
engine:
  id: system1-omni
  name: system1-omni
  repository: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/system1-omni
  ref: e66ff34996760a84ad56690f0ae4cf434e669e65
runtime:
  backend: cuda
  precision: fp16
hardware:
  vendor: NVIDIA
  model: L40S
  device_count: 1
environment:
  os: Linux
  requirements:
  - One allocated NVIDIA L40S, Python 3.12, Git, curl and a stable Rust toolchain capable of Cargo resolver 3.
  - Install src/models/lfm2/requirements.lock.txt (recorded torch 2.14.0 and transformers 5.17.0); a compatible
    NVIDIA driver is required.
  - The worker loads LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M at 9e6c6ccf47cd318696e137d381a7ded8fe4df09f.
  - Initial Rust/Python installation and checkpoint download require network access.
commands:
  install: |
    git clone https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/system1-omni.git
    cd system1-omni
    git checkout e66ff34996760a84ad56690f0ae4cf434e669e65
    python3.12 -m venv .venv-lfm
    .venv-lfm/bin/python -m pip install -r src/models/lfm2/requirements.lock.txt
    source .venv-lfm/bin/activate
    cargo build --release --locked
  serve: |
    # First terminal, from the repository root with .venv-lfm activated:
    (cd src/models/lfm2 && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES-0}" python worker.py \
      --candidate-batch-size 16 --device cuda --dtype float16 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000)
    # Second terminal, from the same repository root after worker readiness:
    OMNI_JEV_BIND=127.0.0.1:8080 OMNI_JEV_BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 \
      ./target/release/omni-jev
  request: |
    curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
    curl --fail-with-body http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/systemone \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"model":"lfm2.5-350m","state":"I was charged twice. Please refund the duplicate charge. No hurry.","questions":{"refund":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Does the customer ask for a refund?","criteria":{"yes":"A refund is requested","no":"No refund is requested"}}}}'
  benchmark: null
deployment:
  status: unverified
  last_verified_at: null
  evidence_url: null
acceptance:
  verdict: INCONCLUSIVE
  issue_url: null
  evidence_url: null
maintainers:
- prettygirlisnotme
updated_at: '2026-10-19'
limitations:
- This deployment ref has not been re-run on L40S during catalog work; historical reports identify earlier Python
  source by hashes and an earlier Rust frontend commit.
- This path is a Python Transformers FP16 worker behind a Rust frontend, not native Rust/CUDA model execution.
- Only text state and independent choice questions are supported by this worker. Confidence is normalized entropy
  concentration, not calibrated correctness.
- 'Historical exact hardware, evidence and boundaries: https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/system1-omni/blob/e66ff34996760a84ad56690f0ae4cf434e669e65/recipe/lfm2/README.md'
- The Linux distribution and current Rust/CUDA runtime must be captured in remote validation. Keep the worker and
  frontend running in separate terminals.
- No repository-wide root license was found at this ref. Preserve component notices, the MIT RLCD reference notice
  and the model license; repository-wide licensing remains a maintainer follow-up.
